metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Phoenix, Arizona reach at least 110 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search-strategy - Need daily maximum land-surface (or 2-m air) temperature for a single pixel centered on Phoenix, AZ, 15–21 Jun 2017. - ERA5-Land (hourly, 0.1°) gives Tmax directly and is always global → will succeed even if Landsat/Sentinel are cloudy. 2. Cloud-masking -ERA5 does not contain clouds; we’ll take the 02:00 UTC value (nighttime) for “max” of 15–21 June 2017 (UTC) as a conservative test; if any pixel is ≥ 110 °F ( 43.3 °C), we answer “Yes”. 3. Catching bad cases - Check collection size(); if 0 → C1. - Reduce to mean value; if None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise compare with 43.3 °C threshold and output A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time phoenix = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.074, 33.4484]) start, end = '2017-06-15', '2017-06-22' # inclusive 15-21 # 2. Data Acquisition era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')\ .select('temperature_2m')\ .filterDate(start, end) if era.size().getInfo()==0: print("No ERA5 images found.") print("C1") else: # convert K → °C; keep max value over week per pixel maxC = era.map( lambda img: img.subtract(273.15) ).max().clip(phoenix) # 3. Calculation val = maxC.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=phoenix, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() # 4. Validation & Answer if val is None: print("Result is null.") print("C3") else: fah = val * 9/5 + 32 print(f"Max T: {val:.1f} °C / {fah:.1f} °F, Pixels: 1") print("A" if fah >= 110 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
phoenix = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.074, 33.4484])
start, end = '2017-06-15', '2017-06-22'             # inclusive 15-21

# 2. Data Acquisition
era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')\
        .select('temperature_2m')\
        .filterDate(start, end)

if era.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("No ERA5 images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # convert K → °C; keep max value over week per pixel
    maxC = era.map(
        lambda img: img.subtract(273.15)
    ).max().clip(phoenix)

    # 3. Calculation
    val = maxC.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=phoenix,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()

    # 4. Validation & Answer
    if val is None:
        print("Result is null.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        fah = val * 9/5 + 32
        print(f"Max T: {val:.1f} °C / {fah:.1f} °F, Pixels: 1")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if fah >= 110 else "<answer>B</answer>")
